assertion.statement: The action of geometric endomorphisms of W0 on V_ell(W0) is faithful, using the lattice comparison after fixing Qbar embedded into C.
assertion.objects: The actual W0=Res_K/Q A and its geometric endomorphisms.
assertion.hypotheses: Fix Qbar into C; finite torsion points agree after this algebraically closed extension; the integral lattice action is faithful as established separately at1184–1193.
assertion.quantifiers: Every geometric endomorphism of the actual W0 and each rational prime ell.
assertion.uniformity: Natural with respect to endomorphisms through their complex-linear lifts.
assertion.normalizations: Covariant Tate module formed from torsion points; integral lattice tensor Z_ell.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The comparison does not supply good reduction, inertia triviality, induced representation, or subsequent morphism descent.
assertion.limit_order: Use the integral lattice injection first, compare its ell-adic completion, then infer faithfulness of the Tate action.

use.reason: Equation(41) identifies the Tate module with the completed analytic lattice compatibly with endomorphisms. A zero Tate action gives a zero integral lattice matrix because Z embeds in Z_ell; the prior faithful lattice action then gives the zero endomorphism.

supplier.statement: For a complex abelian variety A with analytic uniformization lattice Lambda, T_ell A is naturally isomorphic to Lambda tensor_Z Z_ell, compatibly with endomorphisms.

publication.title: Introduction to Shimura varieties

available_assertion.statement: For a complex abelian variety A with analytic uniformization lattice Lambda, T_ell A is naturally isomorphic to Lambda tensor_Z Z_ell, compatibly with endomorphisms.
available_assertion.objects: A complex abelian variety A, its uniformization lattice Lambda, and its ell-adic Tate module.
available_assertion.hypotheses: A is an abelian variety over C; ell is a rational prime.
available_assertion.quantifiers: Every such A and prime ell; every endomorphism of A.
available_assertion.parameter_range: Complex abelian varieties and integral ell-adic Tate modules.
available_assertion.uniformity: Natural with respect to endomorphisms through their complex-linear lifts.
available_assertion.normalizations: Covariant Tate module formed from torsion points; integral lattice tensor Z_ell.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: No arithmetic unramifiedness or field of definition is asserted by this comparison.
available_assertion.limit_order: Identify torsion with Lambda/mLambda and take the inverse limit.
